paragraphs.en: Meeting the moment
paragraphs.zh: 直面当下

paragraphs.en: It is understandable to look inwards in times of crisis, to stick with what's familiar.
paragraphs.zh: 危机时刻人们向内退缩、固守熟悉的一切，实属人之常情。

paragraphs.en: But I believe we must try to help people to look up and out instead, to connect with one another.
paragraphs.zh: 但我坚信，我们必须尽力引导人们抬头放眼外界，与他人建立联结。

paragraphs.en: Good journalism can do this.
paragraphs.zh: 优质新闻报道能够实现这一点。

paragraphs.en: When done well, it can help nourish civic life, build a shared understanding of reality, and forge the kind of connections that people are missing, that people long for.
paragraphs.zh: 优质的新闻报道，可以滋养公共生活，搭建大众对现实的共识，重建人们缺失且渴求的人际纽带。

paragraphs.en: Before I talk about Guardian journalism, I'm going to talk about what makes that journalism possible.
paragraphs.zh: 在介绍《卫报》的新闻理念之前，我先谈谈支撑这份新闻事业存续的根基。

paragraphs.en: Now, I'll admit that the words "ownership model" might not set the pulse racing. But it really matters.
paragraphs.zh: 我承认，“所有制模式”这个词听来平淡乏味，难以让人情绪高涨，但它至关重要。

paragraphs.en: At the Guardian, we have no proprietor demanding political or commercial returns.
paragraphs.zh: 《卫报》不存在谋求政治或商业回报的私人老板。

paragraphs.en: We have no profit-driven shareholders demanding cuts or cash.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有逐利的股东逼迫报社削减开支、榨取利润。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of the Scott Trust, which owns the Guardian, is to keep the Guardian going in perpetuity, serving the public interest, not the interests of the wealthy.
paragraphs.zh: 持有《卫报》的斯科特信托基金会，其设立初衷是让《卫报》永久运营，服务公共利益，而非服务富人阶层。

paragraphs.en: Through this model, the editor-in-chief is permitted – in fact, I can tell you from experience, they are encouraged – to stand up to the powerful, to represent the public interest, to fight for democracy and against autocracy.
paragraphs.zh: 依托这一模式，主编拥有底气——从我自身经历来看，我们更是被鼓励——敢于直面强权，代表公共利益，捍卫民主、反抗威权。

paragraphs.en: This story about our ownership used to feel a bit abstract.
paragraphs.zh: 过去说起这套所有制体系，总显得有些空洞抽象。

paragraphs.en: But then, just before the 2024 presidential election, Jeff Bezos, the owner of the Washington Post, who is worth more than $220bn, prevented the newspaper from publishing its planned endorsement of Kamala Harris.
paragraphs.zh: 但2024年总统大选前夕，身家超2200亿美元、《华盛顿邮报》所有者杰夫·贝佐斯，叫停了报社原定支持卡玛拉·哈里斯的社论背书，此事让一切变得清晰。

paragraphs.en: In January 2025, he was given a prime spot at Trump's inauguration, seated alongside Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg, in front of the new president's cabinet picks.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年1月，特朗普就职典礼上，贝佐斯获安排前排席位，与埃隆·马斯克、马克·扎克伯格并肩落座，正对新任总统提名的内阁成员。

paragraphs.en: The following month, Bezos announced that the Washington Post's opinion pages would be changing.
paragraphs.zh: 次月，贝佐斯宣布《华盛顿邮报》评论版面将全面改版。

paragraphs.en: From now on, their purpose would be solely to champion personal liberties and free markets, he ordered.
paragraphs.zh: 他下令，此后评论板块唯一宗旨就是宣扬个人自由与自由市场。

paragraphs.en: A year later, he laid off hundreds of journalists. Now everyone can see why independent ownership matters.
paragraphs.zh: 一年后，他裁撤数百名记者。至此所有人都能看懂独立所有制的价值。

paragraphs.en: So, thanks to the Guardian's liberating ownership model, we are free to focus on producing journalism without fear of political or commercial interference.
paragraphs.zh: 正因《卫报》这套不受束缚的所有制，我们可以专心做新闻，不必畏惧政治与商业层面的干预。

paragraphs.en: This starts with reporting.
paragraphs.zh: 一切从深度新闻采写开始。

paragraphs.en: We cover the stories that others don't or won't or can't – whether that's our scoops about Peter Mandelson failing his security vetting, or Microsoft's role in military surveillance, or allegations of racist behaviour by Nigel Farage during his schooldays, or who funds him, or investigating who murdered our colleague Dom Phillips in the Amazon, or uncovering the individual stories of the victims of the Minab school bombing in Iran.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报道别家不愿、不能、不敢触碰的事件：从独家曝光彼得·曼德尔森安全审查未通过，到微软参与军事监控，再到奈杰尔·法拉奇学生时代的种族主义言行及其背后的资金来源；我们远赴亚马逊雨林追查遇害同行多姆·菲利普斯的凶手，也细致记录伊朗米纳卜校园爆炸遇难者各自的人生故事。

paragraphs.en: We also believe in the value of collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们同样信奉新闻协作的价值。

paragraphs.en: Working with another news organisation on an investigation shows that we value the public interest over ego-driven journalistic rivalry or zero-sum competition.
paragraphs.zh: 与其他新闻机构联合开展调查，意味着我们把公共利益置于媒体间争名夺利、零和博弈的竞争之上。

paragraphs.en: It means we see ourselves in a civic role, not just a commercial one.
paragraphs.zh: 这代表我们将自身定位为公共服务载体，而非单纯的商业机构。

paragraphs.en: We work tirelessly to establish the facts – and when we get them wrong, we correct them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们竭尽全力核实事实；一旦出现报道失实，便立刻更正。

paragraphs.en: For democracy to survive, for society to progress, we need a shared foundation of facts.
paragraphs.zh: 民主得以存续、社会得以进步，都需要统一的事实根基。

paragraphs.en: If we cannot broadly agree that the grass is green, we cannot have a conversation about what to do about the pollutants that are killing it.
paragraphs.zh: 倘若我们连“青草是绿色的”这一共识都无法达成，便无从探讨如何治理残害植被的污染物。

paragraphs.en: Facts are essential but on their own they are not enough. We also need stories and new ideas that inspire hope.
paragraphs.zh: 事实不可或缺，但仅有事实远远不够。我们还需要能唤起希望的故事与全新思考。

paragraphs.en: Our audience deserves more than simply being told that things are terrible.
paragraphs.zh: 读者不该只被动接收满目疮痍的负面消息。

paragraphs.en: We need to fight the gloom with bold thinking, nuance and thoughtfulness, offering credible visions of a fairer society.
paragraphs.zh: 我们要用大胆的思考、细腻多元的视角、审慎理性的观点消解消沉，勾勒公平社会切实可行的图景。

paragraphs.en: We want our journalism to be nourishing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们希望我们的报道能够治愈人心、滋养精神。

paragraphs.en: We've all experienced that empty, depressing feeling after you've spent time mindlessly scrolling on your phone.
paragraphs.zh: 人人都有过漫无目的地刷完手机后，内心空虚压抑的体验。

paragraphs.en: We aim to be the antidote to that, including in areas beyond news and politics: culture, sport, fashion, wellbeing, travel.
paragraphs.zh: 我们立志成为消解这种负面感受的解药，内容不局限于时政新闻，还涵盖文化、体育、时尚、健康、旅行板块。

paragraphs.en: These are vital parts of a life well lived, and so they are vital parts of our coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 这些都是美好生活不可或缺的组成部分，因此也是我们报道体系中重要的一环。

paragraphs.en: We want to provide journalism that is fun and funny and that will leave you feeling more knowledgeable and more curious about the world.
paragraphs.zh: 我们希望产出有趣、诙谐的新闻内容，让读者读完学识有所增益，对世界生出更多好奇。

paragraphs.en: The reverse of joyless scrolling. The opposite of internet slop.
paragraphs.zh: 它是麻木刷手机的反面，也是网络劣质信息的对立面。
